structured_output.title: Let's Encrypt usage not evident in environment summary
structured_output.content: The change adds a label to Let's Encrypt account keys; cert-manager is installed and Certificate resources are in use (cert-manager.io/v1 CRD present). However, the environment summary does not include issuer configurations, so it cannot be determined whether Let's Encrypt is actually used as an issuer in this cluster. Inspect Issuer and ClusterIssuer resources to confirm Let's Encrypt usage; if present, this label will be applied to account keys created by the issuer.
